name: tag-input
summary: Chips that spring in on Enter or comma and shrink away as neighbours slide over.
props: Called when a tag is added or removed (the removed chip then shrinks out).
Tinted accent chips, filled accent chips, or bordered chips with an accent dot.
Tint each chip from a hash of its label.
Shown before every chip label (e.g. "#"); typed copies are stripped.
Normalise a tag before validation (lowercase, strip spaces…).
Limit; shows a filling ring and "3/5" counter, and locks the input when reached.
Pills under the empty field; while typing, a list with the match highlighted and an "Add …" row.
Characters that commit a tag (Enter always does).
Reject a tag (the field shakes); return a string to show it as the error.
Message under the field; errors shake once.
Style for the outer wrapper around the field, suggestions and message (the one that shakes).
behavior: Enter or a separator commits the text as a chip. Backspace in an empty field highlights the last chip, and a second press removes it.
Chips pop in on a spring and shrink out on removal; duplicates bump and a rejected tag shakes the field.
Each chip has a 'Remove' button and each suggestion an 'Add' button; error messages land in a polite live region and the counter reads '3 of 5 tags'.
The browser focus outline on the input is removed; the field draws its own focus state.
